_comment: Context-aware (ABAC) rules, evaluated by auth/dependencies.py. They run alongside the existing role checks in web/auth.py and never replace them. Combining: any matching deny wins, then any matching allow, otherwise deny. A matching rule whose condition attribute is missing denies. Entries with "confirm": true are interpretations that need product sign-off.
_timezone_comment: IANA zone used to evaluate request_time. Override with the ABAC_TIMEZONE env var. CONFIRM: UTC is a placeholder.

rules.note: Roadmap: analyst -> CVE Pipeline allowed only if target_severity == Critical.
Roadmap: viewer -> SQLi scan denied unless from an internal network. NOT a substitute for target authorization (web/scan_authz.py).
Reads 'deny unless internal' as 'allow when internal'. Without it the default deny makes the rule meaningless. The existing role check (require_analyst_or_admin) still blocks viewers from scanning.
Roadmap: any role -> NGFW Rules denied outside configured business hours.
Counterpart of the deny rule. Without it the default deny would block NGFW Rules at all hours.
